overview_description.description:
Sumo Logic is a secure, cloud-native, machine data analytics service, that delivers real-time, continuous intelligence from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data across the entire application lifecycle and stack.  It provides log management and analytics services that leverage machine-generated big data to deliver real-time IT insights.

More than 2,000 customers around the globe rely on Sumo Logic for the analytics and insights to build, run, and secure their modern applications and cloud infrastructures. With Sumo Logic, customers gain a multi-tenant, service-model advantage to accelerate their shift to continuous innovation, increasing competitive advantage, business value, and growth. 

Founded in 2010, Sumo Logic is a privately held company based in Redwood City, California, and is backed by Accel Partners, Battery Ventures, DFJ, Franklin Templeton, Greylock Partners, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures and Tiger Global Management.

about_short_description.short_description: Sumo Logic is a provider of cloud-based machine data analytics that enables reliable and secure cloud-native applications.

product.name: Sumo Logic Intelligent Operations Platform
product.description: A cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies log analytics, security operations, SIEM, and observability data for monitoring, investigation, troubleshooting, and response.

product.name: Cloud SIEM
product.description: A cloud-native security information and event management service that correlates security data, triages alerts, detects threats, and supports incident investigation and response.

product.name: Logs for Security
product.description: A security-focused log management service that centralizes cloud and infrastructure logs for threat investigation, compliance, guided search, and security monitoring.

product.name: Log Analytics
product.description: A cloud-based log collection and analysis service for monitoring applications and infrastructure, identifying anomalies, troubleshooting failures, and reducing resolution time.

product.name: Dojo AI
product.description: A multi-agent AI platform that assists with natural-language querying, alert triage, investigation, incident analysis, and remediation across security and operational data.

product.name: Cloud SOAR
product.description: A security orchestration, automation, and response capability that enriches alerts, coordinates workflows, and automates actions during security investigations.
